from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img37 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0037.png"))
# Green leaves:
green = np.argwhere((img37[:,:,1] > 100) & (img37[:,:,0] < 50) & (img37[:,:,2] < 80))
print("Green leaves y range:", green[:,0].min(), green[:,0].max(), "x range:", green[:,1].min(), green[:,1].max())

# Now look below green leaves for the pot:
for y in range(green[:,0].max(), green[:,0].max()+50):
    for x in range(green[:,1].min()-10, green[:,1].max()+10):
        c = img37[y, x]
        if not (c[0] > 240 and c[1] > 240 and c[2] > 240) and not (c[0] < 50 and c[1] > 100):
            print(f"y={y}, x={x}: {c}")
'
